nextGame.note: Saturday morning home game at Yulman Stadium, and it is Homecoming. Eleven o'clock our time. Tulane has won four games and lost four, and so has Tulsa.

news.headline: Tulane punter William Hudlow is up for a national award
news.summary: Hudlow is one of 65 players nominated for the Burlsworth Trophy, which goes to the best player who started college without a scholarship. He averages 47 yards a punt, the best in his conference.

news.headline: Tulane beats Charlotte 38-31 in overtime
news.summary: Tulane was behind by 10 points in the fourth quarter Friday night and tied the game with 10 seconds left. Dagan Bruno ran it in from the 1-yard line in overtime to win it, and the Green Wave are 4-4.

news.headline: Trace Johnson ties the game with 10 seconds left
news.summary: Tulane's freshman quarterback threw an 11-yard touchdown pass to Cameron Roberts to make it 31-31. In his first start on the road he completed 28 of his 36 throws for 284 yards.

nextGame.note: Saturday night home game in Gainesville. A quarter to seven our time. Florida is 24th in the first playoff rankings. Oklahoma has won four games and lost four.

news.headline: Florida is 24th in the first playoff rankings
news.summary: The committee that picks the playoff teams put out its first rankings Tuesday night. Florida is 24th, and Oklahoma, the team the Gators play Saturday, is not in the top 25.

news.headline: Vernell Brown has no return date after a setback
news.summary: Florida's best receiver hurt his knee again in practice last week, and there was more swelling than the team expected. Coach Jon Sumrall said Monday he does not know when Brown will play again this season.

news.headline: Sumrall will not say who starts at quarterback
news.summary: Jon Sumrall said Monday he has a plan for Saturday against Oklahoma but would not name a starter. Florida's depth chart now lists Aaron Philo or Tramell Jones Jr. instead of one name.

nextGame.note: Saturday morning road game in Columbia, Missouri. Eleven o'clock our time. Texas is 7th in the first playoff rankings. Missouri is 18th in those rankings and has won six games and lost two.

news.headline: Texas is 7th in the first playoff rankings
news.summary: The committee that picks the playoff teams put out its first rankings Tuesday night. Texas is 7th, and Missouri, the team the Longhorns play Saturday, is 18th.

news.headline: Texas will be short-handed at Missouri
news.summary: Coach Steve Sarkisian said Monday that Texas lost a lot of players to injury in Saturday's win and that he does not know yet who will be able to play. Left tackle Trevor Goosby is out for the rest of the season.

news.headline: Texas beats Mississippi State 31-3
news.summary: Texas led 17-0 at halftime on a touchdown pass, a field goal and a fumble run back for a score. The Longhorns have won six games and lost two.

nextGame.note: Sunday home game in the Superdome against Cleveland. Noon our time, and it is this coming Sunday. The Saints had last weekend off. Cleveland lost 27-6 at Pittsburgh last Sunday and has won five games and lost three.

news.headline: Mark Ingram and Terron Armstead enter the Saints Hall of Fame
news.summary: The two old Saints are honored at a luncheon in Kenner on Friday and at a party on Saturday. They get their Hall of Fame jackets on the field before Sunday's game in the Superdome.

news.headline: Saints bring back running back Audric Estime
news.summary: The Saints claimed Estime off waivers from Cleveland on Tuesday. He played for New Orleans last season, and to make room the team let go of kicker Daniel Carlson.

news.headline: Saints let go of their run game coach
news.summary: Coach Kellen Moore said Monday that T.J. Paganetti is out. Offensive line coach Brendan Nugent will run the running game from now on, and the Saints have had trouble running the ball all season.

news.headline: IUP's Jessica Neiman wins a conference weekly award
news.summary: The conference named Neiman its West Division athlete of the week on Monday. She had 32 kills in IUP's two wins last weekend, 17 against Pitt-Johnstown and 15 at California.

news.headline: IUP sweeps California for its eighth win in a row
news.summary: IUP won in three sets on Saturday at California, Pennsylvania. Delaney Concannon had 12 kills and became the third player in school history with 1,000 kills and 1,000 digs.

news.headline: Peyton Belcher helps block three balls against Clarion
news.summary: Peyton played three of the four sets in Friday's win over Clarion and was in on three blocks. She had 3 kills on 14 swings with 4 errors.

news.headline: Cam Schlittler is a finalist for the Cy Young Award
news.summary: Schlittler won 14 games and lost 6, and no pitcher in the American League gave up fewer runs. The award for the league's best pitcher is handed out November 11.

news.headline: Yankees make a big offer to keep David Bednar
news.summary: The Yankees offered their closer a one-year deal worth $23.15 million on Monday, and he has until November 17 to take it or turn it down. They made no such offer to second baseman Jazz Chisholm, who can now sign with any team.

news.headline: Cody Bellinger wins a Gold Glove in left field
news.summary: Bellinger was named the best fielding left fielder in the American League on Sunday. It is the second Gold Glove of his career, and he is the first Yankee to win one in left field since 2016.

nextGame.note: Thursday night home game at Tad Gormley Stadium in City Park, and a district game. Seven o'clock kickoff. This game decides the district. Bonnabel has won six games and lost three and leads the district at 5-0. Warren Easton is 4-1 in the district and sits third, and a win here would pull the Eagles level with Bonnabel at the top.

news.headline: John Ehret beats Warren Easton 35-18
news.summary: Warren Easton lost Thursday night in Marrero. It was the Eagles' first district loss and it ended a four-game winning streak, and it drops them from first place in the district to third.

news.headline: Warren Easton shuts out West Jefferson 44-0
news.summary: The Eagles won at home Saturday afternoon for their fourth win in a row. Warren Easton is 4-4 and has won all four of its district games.

news.headline: Warren Easton wins a third district game, 22-6
news.summary: The Eagles beat East Jefferson 22-6 on Thursday night in Metairie for their third win in a row. Warren Easton is 3-4 for the year and has won all three of its district games.
